title: Derived unit and Leray identity
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $\mathcal A_X$ be its category of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and let $K\in D(\mathcal A_X)$. Write $U=D((\mathrm{id}_X)^{-1})$ for the exact inverse image induced on the derived category [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization], $\eta$ for the unit of $U\dashv R(\mathrm{id}_X)_*$, and $\lambda:R\Gamma_X\circ R(\mathrm{id}_X)_*\simeq R\Gamma_X$ for the Leray comparison [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Write $E:U\simeq\mathrm{id}$ for the localization of the inverse-image identity isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition], followed by the localization identity comparison. In functional order, $R\Gamma_X(E_K)\circ\lambda_{U(K)}\circ R\Gamma_X(\eta_K)=\mathrm{id}_{R\Gamma_X(K)}$. This is an equality of morphisms of derived abelian groups, before applying homology, with no boundedness restriction on $K$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 015M (lemma-compose-derived-functors), with the canonical comparison construction of lemma-compose-derived-functors-general; sites.tex Lemma Tag 03CB (lemma-composition-morphisms-sites). The unbounded extension uses K-injective representatives and the general comparison of Tag 05T2; Tag 015M itself states the bounded-below result.

proof.text: Write U for D((id_X)^*), R for R((id_X)_*), G for RGamma_X, and E:U≅id for mapDerivedCategoryNatIso(upperStarId) followed by mapDerivedCategoryIdIso. The conjugate identity isomorphism of R is obtained by right deriving lowerStarId. The unit equation is eta_id,K followed by R(E_K) equal to the inverse direct-image identity comparison at K. This follows by the underived unit equation, the derived adjunction unit characterization, and uniqueness of transformations of right derived functors extending it.

proof.text: The underived identification (id_X)_* followed by Gamma_X ≅ Gamma_X evaluates sheaves at the terminal object and hence equals Gamma_X applied to lowerStarId. Consequently the Leray comparison for id_X is G applied to the derived direct-image identity comparison: both comparisons satisfy the same equation with the derived global-sections unit. Uniqueness of right derived comparisons identifies them.

source.place: Lemma Tag 05T2 (lemma-compose-derived-functors-general) and Lemma Tag 015M (lemma-compose-derived-functors); sites.tex Lemma Tag 03CB (lemma-composition-morphisms-sites). Categorical elaboration of the corresponding step of the parent node.

proof.text: Naturality of the Leray comparison at E_K rewrites G(eta_id,K); lambda_id,U(K); G(E_K) as G(eta_id,K); G(R(E_K)); lambda_id,K. Substitute the unit equation from step 1 and the identification from step 2. The inverse and forward direct-image identity comparisons cancel, and G preserves identity. The equation holds for every derived object, since all transformations in this argument are on the unbounded derived category computed using K-injectives; no boundedness of K is used.

theorem derivedUnitLeray_id (X : Scheme.{u})
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) :
    (rightDerivedGlobalSections AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X).map
      ((mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (𝟙 X)).unit.app K) ≫
    (rightDerivedLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (𝟙 X)).hom.app
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (𝟙 X)).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≫
    (rightDerivedGlobalSections AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X).map
      ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X) ≪≫
        Functor.mapDerivedCategoryIdIso
          (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).hom.app K) = 𝟙 _
